messages:
maya: scheduling an alpha-stripe v2 rollout in the 04:00 UTC change window. plan: tenant-scoped canary (5 tenants) -> 10% global -> hold 30m. need final rollback triggers, tenant-quarantine thresholds, and release-note callouts.

josh: adding note: a subset of server-to-server integrations send extra enum values; v2 will 422 on unknown enums. recommend tenant-by-tenant fallback for the first 24h and an advisory to integrators.

ops_lee: proposed safety rules: 1) global 5xx > 0.4% for 3m -> rollback. 2) any tenant error rate > 1.5% over 2m -> auto-quarantine that tenant. 3) sustained p95 > 650ms for 2 consecutive 1m buckets -> pause expansion. also set burst-protection: if sudden traffic spike >3x baseline within 1m -> hold.

sara: docs: will add a migration blurb and customer advisory. callout for unknown-enum 422s and example mitigation code. PR draft: https://go/internal/docs/pull/3311 (WIP).

maya: deploybot, schedule action for 2025-09-09T04:00:00Z. tag rollout id rb-3199990000 and enable tenant quarantine.

deploybot: action scheduled by maya for 2025-09-09T04:00:00Z. action: tenant-scoped canary -> up to 5 tenants (id list supplied). monitor_id: rb-3199990000. will attach `rollout_id` tag to traces and capture failed payloads to s3://rollouts/rb-3199990000/failed.

josh: client teams: please ensure integrator contacts are pre-notified. we'll include sample reconciliation query for missing enums.

ops_lee: preflight checks passed. starting tenant-scoped canary now.

deploybot: tenant canary started at 2025-09-09T04:00:00Z -> tenants: t-102,t-205,t-303,t-404,t-509 routed to v2. monitor rb-3199990000. will enforce tenant quarantine policy.

ops_lee: initial health: p50 100ms, p95 200ms, 5xx 0.015%. good so far.

josh: observed small bump of 422s from tenant t-303 (unknown enum). capturing payloads and notifying their integrator. recommend quarantining t-303 until they patch.

sara: adding a known-issue to the release notes: "If you see 422 with unknown enum, update allowed values or call our migration endpoint."

maya: agree quarantine t-303. deploybot, quarantine action and update pinlist.

deploybot: tenant t-303 quarantined to v1 at 2025-09-09T04:06:12Z (event q-3199990000). pinlist updated. notification sent to account team.

ops_lee: after quarantine: p95 210ms, 5xx 0.02%. safe to proceed to 10% global if no other issues.

josh: mobile SDK note: older SDK v0.x may mishandle error payloads when 422 returns; recommending retry-backoff patch in SDKs before global ramp.

maya: decision: hold 30m at tenant canary while mobile SDK patch rolls to alpha. if stable, we'll manually bump to 10% global after patch validation. rollback CLI below for ops if thresholds are breached.

```
# emergency rollback
deploybot rollback --route /api --from v2 --to v1 --monitor rb-3199990000 --reason "auto-threshold"
```

ops_lee: alerts wired to @eng-oncall + runbook link. auto-rollback will run after 60s confirmation when thresholds met. also wired burst-protection alerts.

deploybot: status update at 2025-09-09T04:12:00Z: tenant canary active (4/5 tenants after quarantine), partial routing to v2 for remaining tenants. will not auto-expand to global without manual approval.

sara: docs PR updated with migration snippet and advisory. will send customer advisory to affected integrators for t-303.

josh: keeping an eye on SDK alpha rollout, will report back in 25m with ramp recommendation. :eyes:

maya: thanks team. leaving thread open for follow-ups. if rollback executes, please paste the CLI output here and tag #eng-oncall.
